note: The fixture pair for pool-sizing (L13 in fixtures/PLAN.md), Kubernetes and Prisma 7.10.1 form, scanned with pool-sizing alone. Written by hand: each planted defect is fixed in place in the clean twin, line for line, and the twins differ in nothing else. A finding catches a defect when its check matches and its locations name the defect's file, line, column and symbol (every place, when the defect lists several), with the defect's severity. Decoys are in both twins; reporting one is a false positive. The database is managed; erlang.config.json gives its max_connections, 200, and the default 3 are reserved. Paths are relative to each twin. Nothing here is installed or run.
